description: Memo keys separate strict queries and two different families (engine §2.2, §4, and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $c:c
%conditions ¬$c.without-elision.matches(w), $c.without-elision-except(yes).matches(w), ¬$c.without-elision-except(no).matches(w), ¬$c.without-elision.matches(w)
%rule c X [+T] B
%rule w X [+U] [+T] B
%rule yes w
%rule no Z
